name: formaai
description: FormaAI — open-source, BYOK, template-driven AI report generation platform

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @formaai/shared && npm run build --workspace @formaai/docx-engine && npm run build --workspace @formaai/ai-providers && npm run build --workspace @formaai/api && npm run build --workspace @formaai/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @formaai/api && npm run test --workspace @formaai/docx-engine && npm run test --workspace @formaai/ai-providers && npm run test --workspace @formaai/shared && npm run test --workspace @formaai/web
scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @formaai/api & npm run dev --workspace @formaai/web
